result:
If I could change one thing, it would be to make empathy unavoidable.

Not just sympathy or politeness, but the actual felt sense that other people’s reality is real and matters as much as your own. If people could reliably feel the weight of what they’re doing to each other and to the world, most cruelty, greed and short-term thinking would collapse on its own.

Everything else — better policy, better science, better cooperation — tends to follow from that.
